card.name: Pancreas and blood sugar terms
card.fires_on: Words inside or just after pancreas and blood-sugar terms, such as Pancre-atic, hypo-glycemic, Islet, and 'history of' before pancreatitis. It appears in diabetes, insulin and pancreatic-disease text.
